facts: Saudi Ministry of Commerce reported more than 71,000 commercial registrations issued in Q2 2026.
The same release reported more than 1.91 million active commercial registrations.
The release highlighted tourism attractiveness and promising Vision 2030 activities including e-commerce and cloud computing.
signals.what_it_proves: Broad Saudi business formation and official attention to selected growth activities.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Named buyer pain, relationship, consent, budget, decision access, urgency or purchase intent.
dealix_use: account-list research from lawful/public sources only

facts: CST guidance covers AI for internal operations, customer-facing use and AI agents.
The guide frames readiness across business context, data, infrastructure, skills and culture.
signals.what_it_proves: AI adoption/readiness is an active operational topic for Saudi technology companies.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: That any named company needs Dealix or has authorized outreach.

facts: CST provides a technology-enterprise registration and reference-directory service for organizations in IT and emerging technologies.
The service page states registration is currently optional and has no registration fee.
signals.what_it_proves: A regulator-maintained technology-company classification/reference surface exists.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Consent to contact, partnership, qualification, customer need or endorsement by CST.

facts: GASTAT lists Tourism Establishments Statistics for Q1 2026 as the latest quarterly publication in the category.
signals.what_it_proves: Current official tourism-establishment data is available for evidence-backed sector research.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: A specific hospitality operator has a qualified problem or budget.

facts: GASTAT publishes a monthly Construction Cost Index and lists 2026 releases through June/July on the current statistics page.
signals.what_it_proves: A current official source exists for construction input-cost movement and cost-pressure research.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Project award volume, named-customer pain, deal probability or automation ROI.

facts: Wave 25 covers notified taxpayers above SAR 187,500 in VAT-taxable revenue in 2022-2025.
The published integration deadline for notified Wave 25 taxpayers is 2027-02-01.
signals.what_it_proves: A time-bound technical integration requirement exists for notified taxpayers in the stated wave.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: That Dealix is a tax adviser, certifier, approved solution provider, or that a named taxpayer needs Dealix.

facts: NCA publishes minimum cybersecurity controls relevant to the defined private-sector population outside critical national infrastructure.
signals.what_it_proves: A formal control framework exists for relevant private-sector organizations.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: Certification status, applicability to every company, non-compliance, audit authority or permission to make legal conclusions.
dealix_use: readiness artifact generation with human/compliance review

facts: SAMA announced licensing activity for fintech companies providing open-banking services after the regulatory sandbox phase.
signals.what_it_proves: Open banking has an active regulated commercial ecosystem in Saudi Arabia.
signals.what_it_does_not_prove: That Dealix is regulated, licensed, endorsed, or permitted to provide a regulated financial service.

activation_policy.named_customer_progression_requires: real interaction plus evidence-backed state transition
